subject: Web Development
title: Netscape's Fall
description: A micro-lesson that makes Netscape's Fall usable.

hook.text: By 1998, Netscape's market share had plummeted from 80% to under 30%.

buildup.text: Free IE on every Windows machine was impossible to compete with as a paid product.

discovery.text: Netscape made a desperate move: they released their source code to the world as open source.

twist.text: AOL bought Netscape for $4.2 billion, mostly for the web portal, not the browser.

climax.text: Netscape the company died. But its open-source code would rise again as Firefox.

punchline.text: A dead browser planted the seed for its successor.

quiz.question: What did Netscape do with its source code before dying?
